compiled_state.title: Create migration-sweep E2E test driving deterministic detector with per-case selectors + committed baseline
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: Running the migration-aware planner against the fixture emits a migration-class marker and an automated-sweep / manual-verification pair, captured as tool output. (Asserted at SCHEMA LEVEL — see below.)
- dd-3: When the sweep leaves the omitted site, the verification completeness assertion exits non-zero and surfaces the specific missed site.
- dd-4: Running the RED-phase committed baseline planner against the same fixture produces no migration-class marker and no paired structure.
- dd-5: The fixture and its bash test are deterministic — no network, clock, or random dependence — asserted by a repeatable run producing identical output.
- dd-7: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.

## Implementation
Create tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh + a committed baseline-expected.txt fixture + a REPO-ROOT .test-index entry. The E2E drives the REAL deterministic detector plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh — NOT the LLM task-decomposer (dd-5 determinism). It runs an inline detection_query re-query against an mktemp-copied swept copy of the task-1 fixture, performs a committed-baseline byte-diff, asserts double-run byte-identity, and on sg-unavailable emits a loud 'SWEEP-E2E-SKIPPED: sg unavailable' and asserts the inconclusive path. NO new production helper script (no verify-sweep-completeness.sh / emit-sweep-pair.sh) — the re-query reuses the existing detection_query inline.

SCHEMA-LEVEL dd-2 binding (Dependencies finding): the "pair" assertion is bound to the SCHEMA LEVEL — assert the marker carries the detection_query structural-contract field (the field from which the automated-sweep/manual-verification pair-emission is generated). Do NOT assert on actual live LLM pair-emission prose; the live pair-emission consumer (1c2b) is NOT required to be live for this E2E, and no AC requires live pair-emission output.

Expose a `--case <name>` selector (cases: missed-site, clean-sweep, marker, baseline, determinism, sg-skip) so each DD's AC invokes its case independently (mirrors sibling 982a's test-migration-pair-order.sh per-case pattern). chmod +x. Document the baseline-expected.txt regeneration procedure in the test header. Register in the REPO-ROOT .test-index keyed on plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh (append to the existing line).

## TDD Test Spec
Given the task-1 Python fixture and the committed baseline-expected.txt; When test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh drives migration-class-detect.sh against an mktemp swept copy and runs the inline detection_query re-query; Then (a) the marker carries the schema-level detection_query field, (b) --case missed-site exits non-zero and prints the omitted file:line, (c) the committed baseline contains no marker/pair tokens, (d) two runs are byte-identical, (e) under sg-unavailable it prints 'SWEEP-E2E-SKIPPED: sg unavailable' and asserts inconclusive.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] E2E test exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh
- [ ] Test header documents the baseline regeneration procedure
  Verify: grep -qi 'regenerat' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh
- [ ] dd-2 (schema-level pair binding): the emitted marker carries the detection_query structural-contract field (NOT live LLM pair-emission prose; 1c2b need not be live)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=tests/implementation-plan/fixtures/migration-sweep/fixture-config.conf bash plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh legacy_call python tests/implementation-plan/fixtures/migration-sweep | grep -qE '"detection_query":"[^"]+"'
- [ ] dd-3 (distinct): the completeness re-query with the omitted site present exits non-zero AND surfaces the missed file:line
  Verify: out=$(bash tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh --case missed-site 2>&1); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -qE ':[0-9]+'
- [ ] dd-4 (distinct): the committed baseline-expected.txt contains NO migration-class marker and NO automated-sweep/manual-verification pair tokens
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'migration-class.{0,3}sweep|automated-sweep|manual-verification' tests/implementation-plan/fixtures/migration-sweep/baseline-expected.txt
- [ ] dd-5 (distinct, double-run determinism): the test contains the double-run determinism assertion AND the determinism case exits 0
  Verify: grep -qiE 'diff|byte-identical|determinism|run.*twice' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh && bash tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh --case determinism
- [ ] dd-7 / sg-unavailable loud skip: the test emits 'SWEEP-E2E-SKIPPED: sg unavailable' and asserts the inconclusive path
  Verify: grep -q 'SWEEP-E2E-SKIPPED: sg unavailable' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh && grep -qE 'inconclusive' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh
- [ ] Test does NOT invoke the LLM task-decomposer and creates no new production sweep helper
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'task-decomposer|verify-sweep-completeness.sh|emit-sweep-pair.sh' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh
- [ ] Test exposes a --case selector
  Verify: grep -qE '\-\-case' tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh
- [ ] Registered in repo-root .test-index keyed on migration-class-detect.sh
  Verify: grep -qE 'migration-class-detect\.sh:.*test_migration_sweep_e2e\.sh' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] dd-7: full E2E suite passes against the committed fixture
  Verify: bash tests/implementation-plan/test_migration_sweep_e2e.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #1): dd-3 re-query must RECONSTRUCT the full sg invocation — the marker's detection_query is a BARE ast-grep pattern (e.g. legacy_call($$$)) with NO --lang and NO path, and lang is NOT recorded in the marker. The test must: (a) extract detection_query from the marker JSON; (b) supply --lang python explicitly (hardcode/pin — unrecoverable from marker); (c) pass the swept-copy path: sg --pattern "<detection_query>" --lang python <swept_tree>. Do NOT assume detection_query is directly runnable.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #2, CRITICAL): dd-3 completeness assertion = ANY remaining site (count >= 1) is INCOMPLETE — NOT the >=threshold sweep-classification rule. migration-class-detect.sh has NO count/completeness mode (only a thresholded sweep|db|inconclusive verdict). After the sweep, 1 site remains (the omitted one); 1 < threshold(>=3) would WRONGLY classify as inconclusive/complete if the test reuses detect.sh/threshold logic. The completeness check MUST run sg directly, COUNT matches, and assert incomplete when count>=1 (zero-remaining = complete). Add an AC explicitly forbidding reuse of the threshold comparison for completeness. Verify: the test source shows a direct sg count with a >=1 (not >=threshold) incomplete condition.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #3): dd-3's independent site count MUST replicate detect.sh's test-file path exclusion (paths matching test/, _test., .test.) so the two counts stay aligned. Note: detect.sh's import-line filter is effectively dead code (it cut -d: -f4- but this sg version emits path:line:content = 3 fields), harmless for this fixture because the legacy_call($$$) pattern doesn't match import lines. The fixture's 5 sites must be genuine call expressions (not imports). A follow-up bug is filed for the detect.sh dead import-filter.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #4, IMPORTANT): dd-4 baseline semantics — detection (closed 7913) is ALREADY landed, so running detect.sh today against the fixture ALREADY emits a sweep marker; a 'no-marker baseline' is NOT producible by running current detect.sh. Pin: baseline-expected.txt is a HAND-AUTHORED committed file representing the hypothetical pre-epic planner output (NO MIGRATION_CLASS marker, NO pair). The test asserts a POSITIVE DIFFERENTIAL: the CURRENT migration-aware run HAS the marker+pair-contract-field while the committed baseline does NOT (proving the epic added them). dd-4's own AC already asserts the baseline file contains no marker/pair tokens; ADD that the test asserts the current run's output DIFFERS from (is a superset of) the baseline (marker present now, absent in baseline). Document the hand-authored baseline provenance + regeneration in the test header.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #5): the sweep-simulation mechanism MUST be deterministic + idempotent. Recipe: on the mktemp copy, rewrite/remove every legacy_call( line that does NOT contain '# OMITTED-SITE'; preserve the omitted line so it is the ONLY surviving call-expression match post-sweep. Requirements: (a) omitted site is the only surviving match; (b) rewrite is idempotent (double-run determinism depends on it); (c) does not touch import lines or test files. Verify: the test's sweep step is deterministic (--case determinism passes) and post-sweep exactly 1 legacy_call match remains.
comments.author: Test
